facts.fact: Nile Post reports that the Personal Data Protection Office took part with police in a raid on SyncLend Uganda's call centre on 29 October 2026, over failure to register with it under section 29 of the Data Protection and Privacy Act, Cap. 97.

UGA.note: The raid and arrests are an investigation by police with the office, not a decision of the authority on a named organisation.

facts.fact: Nile Post reports police charging 13 suspects on 29 October 2026 under sections 29(i) and 35 of the Data Protection and Privacy Act, Cap. 97, for failure to register with the PDPO and unlawfully obtaining and disclosing personal data.
